title: Image descriptions: which vision model writes the text of a screenshot or an icon, scope A

corpus.label: scope A
corpus.description: the wiki of a management software (Italian, screenshots)
corpus.source: a markdown export of the wiki, imported as it is
corpus.images_detail: 15,044 screenshots and 1,808 icons described by a vision model; 23 SVG not described

samples.images: 31 images from 4 articles: 4 icons, 3 screenshots inside a sentence, 11 large and 13 medium screenshots
samples.icons: 29 different icons from 8 articles, each with the sentence around it

judge.model: Claude Opus 5.5, three blind judge sessions (the images split in three groups), the key applied afterwards
judge.asks: the best description of each image, the descriptions with errors, a score from 1 to 5
judge.caveat: the judges were strict (typos in labels, O and 0 in codes) and flagged nine of their own verdicts as debatable

gpu_host.use: every model: embeddings, reranker, answers, judges, image descriptions, OCR models
gpu_host.rule: everything stays in the 16 GB of VRAM, nothing offloaded to the CPU

cpu_host.use: gosidian, the plugins, Qdrant and PostgreSQL, the converters that run on the CPU

settings: vLLM with --max-model-len 4096, one image per prompt, 8 requests at a time; Ollama 2 at a time

models.resolution: scaled to about 1 MP or more (Ollama's default)

prompts.prompt: v2: what the icon does in the sentence
v3: what it shows (shapes, symbols, colours), the text on the button, what it does

notes: best and errors count images (out of 31, or out of 29 icons); the icon and screenshot scores are the means on those images
full_run_h: estimated hours for the 16,736 images still to describe at that speed

Ollama scales every image to about 1 MP or more (a 16x16 icon costs 1,031 tokens); vLLM at the original resolution uses about a third of the tokens, and its descriptions leave out values Ollama reads (names, ports, dates, codes). At equal resolution vLLM gives Ollama's result 2.5 times faster

prompt v3 against v2 on Gemma 4: better in 23 icons of 29, but more errors, nearly all in naming the shape; a more cautious v3.1 removed some errors and made the descriptions vague (v3 preferred in 20 of 29)
236 screenshots larger than 2 MP were scaled down for the model (max_pixels)

choice.what: two passes on vLLM: screenshots with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct FP8 at a minimum of 1 MP, icons with Gemma 4 12B QAT and prompt v3
choice.why: no model is clearly best on screenshots; Gemma 4 wins on icons and makes more errors on screenshots; Qwen3-VL on vLLM at 1 MP equals Ollama in 40% of the time
